service.name: persona
service.description: Holds the identity an agent transacts as, retrieves the codes a machine cannot receive on its own, and turns every wall it cannot cross into a resumable handoff

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o persona-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

agent-manager.description: Owns run identity. Persona binds persona_id into Claims.Meta and verifies every act-as through agent-manager's live endpoint; token parsing, scope intersection, and attenuation are never reimplemented here.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Act-as is refused and the refusal is journaled. Reads, the operator console, and human handoff completion remain available. There is no degraded evidence grade and no override.

document-manager.description: Sole store for identity documents. Persona holds a binding and a release-into-handoff verb, never document bytes, so sensitivity classification and the append-only custody journal stay in one place.
document-manager.degraded_behavior: Binding and release are refused; existing bindings remain listable. No document content is ever cached locally to fall back on.

secrets-manager.description: Holds mailbox and channel provider credentials. A persona records which credential to use and never the secret value itself.
secrets-manager.degraded_behavior: Affected channel adapters report unavailable and code retrieval is refused for them; other adapters continue. No credential was cached to leak.

prompt-manager.description: Optional source of act-as grants expressed as ordinary team member configuration, keeping organisational policy where teams already live.
prompt-manager.degraded_behavior: Falls back to locally held persona ACL entries. Access becomes narrower, never wider.

device-control.description: Optional one-time-code adapter that leases a phone and reads a code through its existing bounded-action pattern.
device-control.degraded_behavior: That single adapter reports unavailable; other OTP adapters continue. Never falls back to another persona's route.

notification-hub.description: Optional relay that delivers handoffs to the operator's preferred device.
notification-hub.degraded_behavior: The built-in handoff queue serves the operator directly and no handoff is lost; only cross-device delivery is absent.
